unresolved.why: AM is read as the top cover/manway mark, not the nozzle: AM and BM denote the 24" ID manways on V-2502 (0007A) and V-2503 (0008), so M is the manway letter in this mark family. The top process nozzle therefore carries AO, matching the top-nozzle mark on both columns. DW labels the internal dip pipe rather than the bottom nozzle, so the bottom port is left unmarked.
